# Human–AI Collaboration Protocol

This course integrates AI into teaching — **without handing answers over to AI**.

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## The Thinking Rule

**Human produces → AI challenges → Human adjudicates.**

The right to produce and to adjudicate always stays with the human. AI may only take over the "challenge" step.
:::

## Core Principles

| Principle | Meaning |
|---|---|
| AI **does not think** for you | You must first produce a judgment, evidence, and reasoning before letting AI in |
| AI is only a challenger | AI plays the devil's advocate, the mirror, the sanity checker — never an answer machine |
| Human keeps final say | For every AI suggestion, you explain why you accept or reject it, and record your reason |

## Five Sparring Roles

All agents are designed as "sparring / challenging" types — never "answer" types.

| Role | Trigger | Function | Thinking step guarded |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Socratic Mirror** | When you ask "is this right?" | Only asks questions, never gives answers | Produce + challenge |
| **Devil's Advocate** | After you produce a judgment | **Plays the opposition**: evidence, counterexamples, hidden assumptions | Final adjudication (defense) |
| **Sanity Checker** | After elasticity / cost calculations | Independently recalculates, checks units and assumptions | Verification |
| **Sector Analyst** | When discussing industry cases | Adds background, cross-country comparisons, overlooked stakeholders | Broaden perspective |
| **Put theory into practice** | When learning any theory or tool | Stress-tests where and under what conditions a theory actually works | Grounding |

## Companion Skill Packets (Advanced)

- **`/case-challenge`**: Input a case + your judgment; invoke the challenger for a structured debate; output your strongest / weakest link — universal across the course.
- **`/decision-gym`**: Standardized decision rehearsal (time-limited, role info cards, instant reveal) — for Lectures 4, 8–10.
- **`/reflection-log`**: Collect "what reason I ultimately accepted / rejected from AI" — throughout the course and at the close, deposited for self-reflection and class-evaluation.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Scope**: This protocol is the course's pedagogical thinking framework. Each lecture (I hope) ends with a "Human–AI Collaboration Card" that gives the sparring role and one challenge question for that lecture.
:::
